g.text: - Is there a possibility, that two users got the lock for the seat at the same time?

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - No, it is not possible with REDIS SET NX command as it is atomic in nature (READ + WRITE in one step as single Ops)

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: How will the system ensure a good user experience during high-demand events with millions simultaneously booking tickets?

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - With popular events, seats can go stale quickly, this can lead to bad user experience

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - So we can introduce Virtual Waiting Queue for Extremely popular events
